name: The Solar System, World by World
description: A guided tour from the Sun to the Kuiper belt: every planet, the strangest moons, comets, lost worlds and the telescopes and probes that revealed them.

checkpoints.name: The birth of the planets
checkpoints.note: A cloud of gas and dust collapses into the Sun and a disc of planets. Giant impacts shape Earth, the Moon and others, and the leftover rock and ice settle into belts.

checkpoints.name: Wanderers in the night sky
checkpoints.note: For thousands of years people track the five bright planets and the occasional comet by eye, record Halley's Comet, and argue over whether the Earth or the Sun is at the centre.

checkpoints.name: The telescope reveals new worlds
checkpoints.note: Galileo sees moons around Jupiter, astronomers find Uranus and Neptune, comets break apart, and Pluto joins the list in 1930.

checkpoints.name: Robots visit every planet
checkpoints.note: Voyager, Galileo, Cassini, Rosetta and New Horizons fly past, orbit and land, revealing volcanoes on Io, oceans on icy moons, and a heart on Pluto.
